sentences.text: Arpagodus was a member of the class Chondrichthyes, a group of cartilaginous fish.
Scientists St. John and Worthen first described the genus in 1875.
Fossils are found mainly from the Pennsylvanian subperiod, including sites in Russia and the Raytown Limestone Formation in Kansas, USA.
This animal belongs to the family Helicoprionidae, a parent group of ancient sharks.
Today, the genus contains only the single species A. rectangulus.
